evaluation_target.statement: Determine whether the current operational situation requires a braking maneuver to avoid collision.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: The collision-relevant spatial situation between the ego vehicle and obstacles on or near its trajectory.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Concern-relevant properties of obstacles and their spatial relationship to the ego vehicle, including obstacle presence, source-required obstacle categories, and relative distance where these properties can change whether braking is required.

crds.rationale: Collapsing obstacle presence and absence removes information required to determine whether braking is required.
The visible source explicitly requires this category distinction within the obstacle information supporting the braking concern.

crds.dimension: Obstacle distance relative to braking need
crds.contrast_b: Distance condition does not require braking
crds.rationale: Relative distance can change whether braking is required; no numerical threshold is introduced because the dangerous-zone boundary is tbd and the 20 m value is scenario-specific.

orrs.preservation_obligation: The Observable Representation shall preserve whether a collision-relevant obstacle is present in the operational situation.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: ObstaclePresent_R(x) != ObstaclePresent_R(y) for situations separated by H1-CRD1.
orrs.rationale: Without this distinction the representation cannot support evaluation of whether an obstacle-induced braking condition exists.

assumptions.statement: The obstacle-information basis used by the Observable Representation continues to support distinguishing collision-relevant obstacle presence from absence.

revalidation_conditions.statement: Revalidate if the obstacle-detection requirements, the architectural responsibility for obstacle information, or the information supplied for representing obstacle presence changes.

orrs.preservation_obligation: The Observable Representation shall preserve the source-required distinction between vulnerable road users and other objects when an obstacle is represented.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: VRU_R(x) != VRU_R(y) for situations separated by H1-CRD2.
orrs.rationale: The visible functional specification explicitly requires this category distinction within obstacle information supporting the braking concern.

assumptions.statement: The source-required distinction between vulnerable road users and other objects remains part of the obstacle information relevant to the concern.

revalidation_conditions.statement: Revalidate if FR-7.2.2, the object-category scheme, or the architectural responsibility or information used to represent object category changes.

orrs.preservation_obligation: The Observable Representation shall preserve whether the spatial relation between the ego vehicle and an obstacle falls in a condition requiring braking or one not requiring braking.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: BrakingRelevantDistanceClass_R(x) != BrakingRelevantDistanceClass_R(y) for situations separated by H1-CRD3.
orrs.rationale: Distance is explicitly required for the braking concern, but the dangerous-zone boundary is tbd; therefore the ORR preserves the concern-relative distance class without inventing a numerical threshold.

assumptions.statement: The representation continues to receive information sufficient to distinguish braking-relevant spatial conditions of obstacles relative to the ego vehicle.

revalidation_conditions.statement: Revalidate if the distance or spatial-information requirement, the dangerous-zone definition, or the architectural responsibility or information used to determine the ego-object spatial relation changes.

lifecycle_change.title: Dangerous-zone definition introduced
lifecycle_change.description: The previously unspecified dangerous-zone boundary is replaced by an explicit configurable braking-zone definition determined by the active operational profile. The engineering concern and Phenomenon of Interest remain unchanged.
